# GitHub Copilot Instructions

When generating or editing Kotlin/Android docs, examples, scanner logic, or skill files, follow:

- `specs/finance-number-skill.md`
- `specs/rtl-adaption.md`
- `specs/kotlin-style.md`

Keep `skills/android-finance-spec/references/` synchronized with root `specs/`.
